name: sambapos-lba
description: SambaPos_LBA — POS web moderno para restaurantes (root package for Capacitor/Android)

scripts.cap:sync: cd backend && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:add: cd backend && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:copy: cd backend && npx cap copy android
scripts.cap:open: cd backend && npx cap open android
scripts.build:web: echo 'Frontend is static — no build step needed. WebDir is frontend/'
scripts.build:android:debug: cd backend && npx cap sync android && cd ../android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: cd backend && npx cap sync android && cd ../android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
